paragraphs: Payment processors and card network switches operating in India are subject to strict Reserve Bank of India controls governing cryptographic key lifecycle management and payment telemetry. Traditional software-based key storage mechanisms expose sensitive master session keys to memory scraper attacks and hypervisor side-channel leakage. Furthermore, periodic regulatory audits struggle to verify continuous compliance due to fragmented, asynchronous system logs across disparate payment gateway switches.

Our solution bridges FIPS 140-2 Level 3 Hardware Security Modules directly with air-gapped core banking execution enclaves via isolated PKCS#11 hardware channels. Incoming ISO 8583 payment authorization requests are decrypted inside volatile cryptographic memory where customer Primary Account Numbers (PAN) and PIN blocks are immediately translated into one-way ephemeral tokens. Zero plaintext payment data ever touches physical storage or general-purpose operating system buffers.

The state machine maintains continuous cryptographic key ceremony verification and tamper-evident health telemetry. Key derivation, rotation, and retirement operations trigger deterministic Merkle DAG entries that are cryptographically counter-signed by the HSM private key. In the event of physical chassis tampering or environmental voltage deviations, the hardware security module executes an automated zeroization protocol within 4 microseconds, rendering all ephemeral keys permanently unrecoverable.

Statutory scoring aligns strictly with RBI Cyber Security Framework Annex II controls for categorized payment systems and NPCI Unified Payments Interface operating guidelines. Automated compliance monitors verify key rotation schedules every 24 hours, publishing zero-knowledge cryptographic proofs to bank audit committees. Sustained telemetry ingestion processes 4,100 cryptographic operations per second with sub-45ms roundtrip latency.

faqs.question: How does the platform satisfy RBI Cyber Security Framework Annex II requirements?
faqs.answer: The platform enforces strict physical separation of cryptographic key storage from application logic, maintains tamper-evident audit logs signed by FIPS 140-2 Level 3 hardware, and guarantees zero plaintext card data remanence across all payment processing tiers.

faqs.question: Can this system integrate with legacy payment switches like Base24 or Postilion?
faqs.answer: Yes. The architecture includes pre-built protocol translators for ISO 8583 (1987/1993/2003 formats) and AS 2805, connecting directly to switch host ports via secure dual-homed network interfaces.

faqs.question: What happens if an HSM module detects physical chassis penetration?
faqs.answer: The internal active tamper detection circuitry immediately interrupts power to volatile key memory and triggers an automated zeroization sequence that erases master session keys in under 4 microseconds.
